title: Compiled medium-02 confirmation checkpoint still collapses after attestation, invoice, and entitlement repair
symptom: After Prompt 17 repaired the entitlement checkpoint, the original medium-02 confirmation artifact still shows SP_ConfirmAttestedRelease as an argless stdcall export with zero parameter coverage and failure -7104. Confirmation is now the final remaining checkpoint that must be narrowed before a broader medium-02 reproof is honest.
smallest_reproducer: Inspect sessions/design_suite/compiled_ingest/spectrum_transaction_release_settlement_suite/medium-02/20260411-125905/runs/08-settlement_reconcile/session/invocables_map.json together with tests/fixtures/spectrum_transaction_release_settlement_suite/src/spectrum_settlement_reconcile.c and the repaired attestation/invoice/entitlement reruns.
trust_impact: Spending a broader medium-02 rerun before confirmation is narrowed would over-credit the family and weaken first-remaining-checkpoint discipline right before the package-scale reproof decision.
allowed_next_actions: inspect only the confirmation-stage run artifact and the smallest likely contract/spec owner seam
patch only the owner seam justified by evidence
rerun only the confirmation checkpoint with repaired predecessors
disallowed_next_actions: spend a broader medium-02 rerun before the confirmation checkpoint is locally trustworthy
jump to hard-01 or hard-02 while the final remaining medium-02 checkpoint is still unresolved
treat the original package-scale medium-02 failure report as still current after three repaired predecessor seams
exit_criteria: The confirmation checkpoint is narrowed to one owner seam or tightly coupled pair, a targeted confirmation proof surface is executed, and the next branch can be chosen from truthful confirmation evidence instead of the stale original package run.
